en.title: AI & Fullstack Web Engineer
en.summary: Informatics graduate (Universitas Teknologi Yogyakarta, 2026) and AI & Fullstack Web Engineer specializing in machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision, and in delivering them through full-stack web applications. Built projects with Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, Next.js, React, and Supabase, including a journal-published facial classification system with 94.5% accuracy and a Top 10 finalist hackathon platform. Focused on data-driven solutions delivered on scope and on time.

skills.items: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, AI Agents, PyTorch, YOLOv11, FaceNet, SVM, Naive Bayes, TF-IDF, Bayesian Optimization
Python, JavaScript, React, Next.js, FastAPI, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet.js
SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Data Cleaning & Validation, Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Data Visualization
Docker, AWS App Runner, Vercel, Git/GitHub, Notion, Trello, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace
Project Scheduling, Progress Tracking & Reporting, Technical Documentation, Cross-functional Coordination
Indonesian (native), English (highest TOEIC score in Aceh Province, 2022)

projects.name: Facial Ethnicity Detection System
bullets: Developed an ethnicity classification system from facial images that achieved 94.5% accuracy; the research was published in a scientific journal.
Extracted facial embeddings with FaceNet (PyTorch) and classified them with an SVM tuned through Bayesian Optimization.
Curated a custom, diverse facial dataset and exposed the model through a FastAPI backend.
projects.tech: Python, PyTorch, FaceNet, SVM, Bayesian Optimization, FastAPI

projects.name: MediSync - AI Hospital Orchestration Platform
bullets: Built a hospital orchestration platform that automates patient triage prioritization.
Integrated AI agents (Strands Agents) to generate clinical diagnosis suggestions for medical staff.
Implemented role-based access for Admin, Doctor, and Nurse users and deployed the backend on AWS App Runner.
projects.tech: Next.js 16, FastAPI, Strands Agents, Supabase, AWS App Runner

projects.name: Jivara - AI Medication & Food Interaction Monitor
projects.context: Capstone Project, DBS Foundation x Dicoding
bullets: Built a real-time computer vision system that detects medications and food through a webcam using YOLOv11.
Combined object detection with AI reasoning models to automatically cross-reference detected items for contraindications.
Delivered instant visual alerts that warn users about dangerous medication-food combinations.
projects.tech: Python, YOLOv11, Deep Neural Networks, Computer Vision

projects.name: Warung Tante - Integrated POS & HRIS System
bullets: Built an integrated point-of-sale (POS) and HR information system (HRIS) with real-time synchronized table states.
Implemented geolocation-based staff check-ins restricted to a 5 km radius using Leaflet.js.
Developed analytics dashboards for sales and staff monitoring.

projects.name: Fiscal Sentiment - Policy Text Classification
bullets: Built text classification models using SVM and Naive Bayes with TF-IDF features to support fiscal policy analysis.

projects.name: ShipPal - B2B Matchmaking Platform
bullets: Built a B2B matchmaking platform ("Tinder for Business") that uses AI agents to match businesses.

projects.name: Landing Pages - Warung Tante & Avocado Sandwich
bullets: Designed and launched landing pages for a restaurant (Warung Tante) highlighting its menu and atmosphere, and for a local band (Avocado Sandwich).
Developed image processing algorithms and researched deep learning implementations for real-time object classification.
Facilitated technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions on modern web frameworks and machine learning.
Coordinated communication with external partners and sponsors, and published innovation project documentation for public engagement.
